points.quote: Your assessment submissions must therefore always be entirely your own work, based on your own learning and appropriately referenced including how you have used Generative AI.
points.gist: Submissions must be entirely your own work and appropriately referenced, including how Generative AI was used.

points.quote: Where a complete assignment is created using Generative AI and represented as a student's own work, this will be regarded as contract cheating in the same way as commissioning an 'Essay Mill' or other third party to complete your work.
points.gist: Submitting a fully AI-generated assignment as your own is treated as contract cheating, like using an essay mill.

points.quote: The University regards the use of Generative AI applications by students to deceive to gain unfair advantage as academic misconduct.
points.gist: Using Generative AI to deceive and gain unfair advantage is academic misconduct.

points.quote: Plagiarism, where AI tools are used to generate output and ideas that are presented or submitted as if they were the student's own work, without proper citation or references.
points.gist: Presenting AI-generated output and ideas as your own without citation is plagiarism.

points.quote: The exception will be for tasks where the extensive and critical use of a specific AI tool is part of the assessment brief.
points.gist: Tasks where extensive and critical use of a specific AI tool is part of the assessment brief are an exception.

points.quote: AI tools sometimes invent information and references when they cannot find it. This is called 'hallucinating.'
points.gist: AI tools sometimes invent information and references, known as hallucinating.

points.quote: For specific guidance related to your subject speak to your course leader or any member of the teaching staff.
points.anchor: Guidance on the use of Artificial Intelligence
points.gist: For subject-specific guidance, speak to your course leader or any member of teaching staff.

points.quote: Visit Skills Hub, a resource that will help you learn how to find and use information for your studies and assessments.
points.anchor: Further Help and Support with AI
points.gist: Skills Hub helps you learn to find and use information for studies and assessments.
